latestVersion.changelog:
Patent Novelty Search Skill v1.0.0

- Introduces an end-to-end workflow for patent novelty search, from initial user input through to generation of a professional novelty search report.
- Supports structured input processing to extract core technical elements (problem, means, effect).
- Provides guidelines for technical feature extraction and formatting.
- Details step-by-step procedures for patent retrieval, emphasizing the use of Google Patents and structured search strategies.
- Implements similarity ranking and comparison analysis of retrieved patents with comprehensive output formats.
- Outputs feature comparison tables and final search reports compiled in Word document format.
